senses.gloss: गृह् €10 Ā. To accept, to take, to seize; L. D. B.

गृहम् [गृह्यते धर्माचरणाय, ग्रह् गेहार्थे क Tv.]
—1 A house, dwelling, habitation, mansion; न गृहं गृहमित्याहुर्गृहिणी
 गृहमुच्यते Pt. 4. 81, 5. 15; पश्य वानरमूर्खेण सुगृही निर्गृहीकृतः Pt. 1. 390.
—2 A wife; (the first quotation in 1 is sometimes erroneously cited as
 an illustration).
—3 The life of a householder; न हि सति कुलवुर्ये सूर्यवंश्या गृहाय
 R. 7. 71, 5. 10; Mv. 4. 28.
—4 A sign of the zodiac.
—5 A name or appellation.
—6 A square (in chess or any other game).

गृहम् + .{@-हाः@} (m. pl.)
—1 A house, dwelling; इमे नो गृहाः Mu. 1; स्फटिकोपलविग्रहा गृहाः
 शशभृद्भित्तनिरङ्कभित्तयः N. 2. 74; तत्रागारं धनपतिगृहानुत्तरेणास्मदीयम् Me. 77.
—2 A wife; अथावलोककोऽगच्छद्गृहानेकः परावसुः Mb. 3. 138. 4.
—3 The inhabitants of a house, family; the life of a householder; गृहानुत्सृज्य
 यो राजन् मोक्षमेवाभिपद्यते Mb. 12. 160. 29.

गृहम् + .{@-हः@} Ved. An assistant, or servant; गृहो याम्यरंकृतो देवेभ्यो
 हव्यवाहनः Rv. 10. 119. 13. In comp. oft. rendered by ‘domestic’,
 ‘household’ or ‘tame’; e. g. ˚कपोतः ‘a tame pigeon’; ˚कार्याणि-कर्माणि
 ‘household duties’; ˚शकुन्तिका ‘tame bird’; छद्मना परिददामि
 मृत्यवे सौनिको गृहशकुन्तिकामिव U. 1. 45 &c.

गृहम् + -देवता the goddess of a house; (pl.) a class of household deities; Ks. 4. 74.

गृहम् + -नमनम् wind.
गृहम् + -नाशनः a wild pigeon.
गृहम् + -नीडः a sparrow.

गृहम् + -पतिः
—1 a householder; वामं गृहपतिं नय Rv. 6. 53. 2; a man who has
 entered on the second stage of life, one who, after having completed his
 studies, is married and settled.
—2 a sacrificer.
—3 the virtue of a householder; i. e. hospitality.
—4 Ved. an epithet of Agni.
—5 the maintenance of the sacred and perpetual fire.
—6 the
[]
 head or judge of a village; Mk. 2; Dk. 8.

गृहम् + -पत्नी Ved. ‘the mistress of a house’, the wife of the householder;

गृहम् + -पालः

गृहम् + -प्रवेशः a solemn entrance into a house according to prescribed rites.
गृहम् + -बभ्रुः a domestic ichneumon.

—1 a crow.
—2 a sparrow; नीडारम्भैर्गृहबलिभुजामाकुलग्रामचैत्याः Me. 23. ˚देवता
 a deity to whom a domestic oblation is offered.

गृहम् + -भङ्गः
—1 one who is driven from his house, an exile.

गृहम् + -भद्रकम् an audience-hall.

गृहम् + -मणिः a lamp.
गृहम् + -माचिका a bat.

गृहम् + -मेघः a multitude of houses; Rām. 5.

गृहम् + -वाटिका, -वाटी a garden attached to a house.

गृहिणी + -पदम् the position or dignity of the mistress of the house; यान्त्येवं

गृहिन् a. [गृह-इनि] Possessing a house. ━m. The master

गृह्य a. [गृह् क्यप्]
—1 To be attracted or pleased, as in गुणगृह्य q. v.
—2 Domestic; गृह्याणां चैव देवानां नित्यपुष्पबलिक्रिया Mb. 13. 141. 43.
—3 Not master of oneself, dependent.
—4 Tame, domesticated.
—5 Situated out-side of; ग्रामगृह्या सेना ‘an army out-side a village’.
—6 Adhering to the party of, being in close relation to; तमार्यगृह्यम् R. 2. 33.
—7 Perceptible; Śvet. Up. 1. 13.

गृह्य a.
—1 To be taken or received.
—2 To be sized.
—3 To be observed, perceptible, perceivable.
—4 To be acknowledged or admitted.
—5 To be trusted or relied on; to be honoured.
—6 Taking the side of, adopting or choosing as best.
—7 Dependent, subservient.
गृह्या A village adjoining to a city; a suburb.

गृह्य + .{@-ह्यः@}
—1 The inmate of a house.

—3 The domestic fire.
